title: Building Founder Authority for a PMS and Investment Advisory Brand
challenge: A boutique investment advisory business had a distinctive investment philosophy but lacked the digital visibility to communicate it to prospective clients.
solution: Myntmore developed a credibility-first LinkedIn strategy focused on investment philosophy, risk management and long-term thinking. Content prioritised education and transparency rather than return promises.
results: Stronger visibility among relevant investor communities.
More informed conversations with potential clients.
